name: second-income-coach
description: Second Income Coach monorepo — Express/Postgres backend, React frontend, shared Zod schemas.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=src" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=src && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=src && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=src && npm run test --workspace=web
